Chapter 572: Chapter 17: Mother Goddess of Lust (Please Subscribe)

The Longshan Ling spans 60 million li, with the vast majority of the region being desolate and uninhabited.

Atop a mountain peak thousands of zhang high, Lin Yuan sat cross-legged alone. The space around him subtly distorted, and a terrifying aura was suppressed within a few dozen zhang of his body.

If he let go of the suppression, it was estimated that in an instant, it could sweep across tens of millions of li.

“Among the numerous bloodlines of the Longshan Family, the ‘Mountain Dragon’ bloodline is the most obvious and the easiest to feel,”

“Thus, the people of the Longshan Family generally focus on excavating the ‘Mountain Dragon’ bloodline.”

“The First Viscount of Longshan from more than two thousand years ago, he managed to excavate the Mountain Dragon bloodline to the fifth rank.”

...

Lin Yuan’s thoughts spread out as he continued to ponder.

“But the easiest to feel doesn’t mean the strongest. Over the years, I have almost completely analyzed my own bloodline, and I’ve discovered another extremely faint bloodline…”

“This bloodline is at least of the ninth rank, perhaps even that of a near-tenth rank, a peak ninth-rank bloodline…”

In the last century, Lin Yuan had not only recovered his strength but had also been studying this world’s cultivation system.

What is called the knight cultivation skill is essentially about excavating the potential deep within one’s bloodline to ultimately achieve ‘returning to the ancestors.’

Under the restrictions of the rules of heaven and earth, even a sixth-rank legendary knight finds it difficult to live past a thousand years; obviously, the slow cultivation methods of the Main Universe are no longer suitable for this world.

Excavating one’s own bloodline and swiftly breaking through by following the pathway trodden by ancestors is what aligns with the trends of this world.

In the human civilization of the Main World, becoming fourth or fifth rank before the age of a hundred is a rare talent for a planet or even a Star Domain.

But in this world, becoming a fourth or fifth level knight before a hundred? Although not common, it certainly isn’t rare.

By excavating the potential of the bloodline, until reaching the upper limit of the bloodline, there are nearly no fetters, with the only issue being how much bloodline potential can be excavated.

“If I want my Martial Path Evolutionary Path to spread in this world, I must make changes. Relying on the original cultivation method, what can I compare with the native knight cultivation skills?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself. The Martial Path Evolutionary Path needs to comprehend the external rules, but deep within the lifeforce bloodlines of this world lies the essence of the corresponding rules.

Comprehend the external rules? Where’s the speed of comprehending the essence of the internal bloodline rules?

Moreover, under the extreme pressure of a limited lifespan, Lin Yuan also began studying bloodlines, adapting the Martial Path Evolutionary Path ‘to suit local conditions.’

“The nearly tenth-tier bloodline hidden within me is rare, but over these years of constant purification, I’ve roughly figured out its origin…”

Lin Yuan raised his right hand, a streak of rainbow light appeared, and a faint, terrifying pressure spread outward.

Rainbow Dragon Clan.

The most powerful life form in this world, born at the dawn of the world’s creation,

It is said that among the twenty-four Prime Gods who reside in the Ocean of Light, one of them belongs to the Rainbow Dragon Clan, known as the Rainbow Dragon God, the ultimate faith of the dragon bloodlines among mortals.

Be it Rock Dragons, Mountain Dragons, or Sub-Dragons, their source of bloodline leads back to the Rainbow Dragon Clan.

“By absorbing many knight cultivation skills from this world, even those kept in reserve by the imperial clan of the empire, and complementing them with ninth-rank Against-Heaven’s Understanding for deduction, I eventually managed to maintain the core of the Martial Arts Evolution System intact, making it focus primarily on excavating the internal bloodline…”

“The altered Martial Path Evolutionary Path… Martial Tao Cultivation Skill enables prioritizing the excavation of the most potent bloodline within one, the bloodline that suits oneself best, instead of being limited to specific knight cultivation skills,”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The many knight cultivation skills of this world are all targeted at specific bloodlines.

For example, the Longshan Family’s Longshan Cultivation Skill can only detect the ‘Mountain Dragon’ bloodline, but it is incapable of discovering other bloodlines.

But Lin Yuan’s ‘localized’ Martial Tao Cultivation Skill doesn’t have this limitation; it might not be stronger than many knight cultivation skills in specific aspects, but it’s suitable for every knight or knight-in-training.

This fact alone would allow the Martial Tao Cultivation Skill to spread rapidly in this world.

Of course, the ‘localized’ Martial Tao Cultivation Skill is only suitable for propagation in this world. As for the Main Universe? If not for the drastically shortened lifespan due to the constraints of the rules of heaven and earth,

naturally comprehending the external rules would be better. This is evident from how the powerful beings of this world, upon becoming demigods, need to rely on the faith of all beings to establish their Divine Kingdoms.

Evolvers from the human civilization of the Main Universe are those who develop their own Inner Worlds without relying on external forces, and they will go further and be free of hidden dangers.

“It’s just that after excavating this bloodline of the Rainbow Dragon Clan, it did indeed make my physical body 60% stronger. The path of bloodline cultivation has its merits.”

Lin Yuan stroked his chin. The 60% increase here refers to the foundational strength of the physical body, not taking into account various enhancements, akin to bathing in the Eternal Spring and improving one’s body.

And Lin Yuan also felt that he had not yet reached the end of his journey into the Rainbow Dragon Clan bloodline; the deeper he delved, the stronger the enhancement to his body.

…

“Over the last hundred years, I’ve also reopened my Inner World and stepped into the Eighth Layer, just needing to accumulate to the peak of the Eighth Layer to effortlessly advance into the Ninth Rank,”

Lin Yuan reined in his aura and stood up from the mountain peak.

Considering the Realm comparison between this world and the Main World, the Eighth Layer is akin to a deity who has established a Divine Kingdom.

And once a deity establishes a Divine Kingdom, they must enter the Ocean of Light or the Abyss of Darkness.

Under the agreement of the twenty-four Prime Gods, deities are not allowed to linger in their True Bodies among mortals, as that would impact all beings, a cost those based on the faith of all beings, the gods, cannot afford.
